best_for: People who juggle personal and work tasks across a PC, a Mac and a phone, and who can live with 5 projects before paying for Pro.

points.title: Free means 5 projects
points.text: The free Beginner plan allows 5 personal projects, 5 collaborators per project, 3 custom filters, 5 MB uploads and one week of activity history. Custom reminders and the calendar layout need a paid plan.

points.title: Pro and Business prices
points.text: Pro is USD 5 per month billed yearly (USD 60) or USD 7 month to month. Business is USD 8 per user per month billed yearly, or USD 10 monthly, plus local tax. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: On every screen you use
points.text: Doist publishes apps for Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone, iPad, Android, Apple Watch and Wear OS, plus browser and email add-ons, so a task you add on the phone shows up on the desktop.

points.title: Linux: official Snap and AppImage
points.text: Doist offers Linux builds as a Snap and an AppImage. The Flatpak listed here is on Flathub under Doist's name, but Flathub does not mark it as verified, and it is x64 only.

points.title: Per-user Windows install
points.text: The Windows installer installs for the current user, in x64 and Arm64 builds, so you do not need administrator rights. Mac builds need macOS 12 or later, for Intel and Apple silicon.

points.title: Downgrades on Windows
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 74 versions. macOS and Linux list only the current release, so going back there needs another source.
